items.title: Utah moves to drop criminal pursuit of Kalshi after the firm halted services there
items.summary: The state continues to hold the criminal charges in its back pocket with a vow to hit Kalshi and other prediction markets with gambling accusations if they return.

items.title: 'AI trade never died': Traders see room for market recovery, but bitcoin's participation is another story
items.summary: Monday's tech enthusiasm is quickly fading on Tuesday, while bitcoin remains near bear-market lows.

items.title: Anchorage Digital to unveil new asset-management subsidiary
items.summary: The crypto custody technology firm said it will unveil a separate subsidiary called 61st Parallel Asset Management.

items.title: South Korea proposes ending 2017 ICO ban to boost jobs and onshore crypto investment
items.summary: Token issuers would have to disclose how they plan to spend investors' money and could face criminal charges for misleading buyers.

items.title: Crypto trader Ansem says his wallet was hacked as $2 million in memecoins were sold
items.summary: Ansem suspects someone broke into his account on Bullpen, the trading terminal he co-founded, where the wallet's private key had been imported.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin pulls back below $60,000, stock rally fades, as tariffs re-enter the picture
items.summary: The Trump Administration could unveil tariff hikes against China, Japan, South Korea and other countries as soon as this week, according to a WSJ report.

items.title: Bitcoin drops as November spot ETF outflows increase to record $4.71 billion
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 24, 2026

items.title: JPMorgan, HSBC and StoneX complete first digital gold trades in London
items.summary: The banks tested a new way to trade fractions of physical gold bars and use the metal as collateral without moving it from vaults for the first time.

items.title: Bitcoin hands back Monday's Nvidia-driven gains, liquidations triple
items.summary: Bitcoin (BTC) has dropped 2.2% since midnight UTC to around $59,900, giving back Monday's jump and lagging the stock market's rebound from last week's selloff.

items.title: Bitcoin’s drop to $55,000 left a record 11.6 million BTC underwater
items.summary: Bitcoin’s supply in profit fell below its 2022 FTX collapse low, while entities holding 100 to 10,000 BTC continued to accumulate.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Europol follows $28.5M crypto trail in streaming piracy crackdown
items.summary: Authorities from 11 countries worked with Binance, Coinbase and Chainalysis to trace financial transactions and disrupt illegal streaming services.

items.title: Utah moves to dismiss criminal charges against Kalshi after trading halt
items.summary: Utah’s attorney general warned that the criminal charges could be refiled if Kalshi resumes operations in the state, while separate civil litigation remains unresolved.

items.title: Bitcoin sell-off driven by weak demand, forced liquidations: 21Shares
items.summary: The crypto asset manager warned that Bitcoin’s downturn could persist amid weak investor demand, while forecasting an uneven recovery across crypto sectors.

items.title: Coldcard reveals how Bitcoin wallet flaw went undetected for over 5 years
items.summary: Coldcard maker Coinkite explained why years of security checks failed to catch the flaw and said it has yet to decide on compensation for affected customers.

items.title: CFTC sets new prediction market rules as more firms seek US entry
items.summary: The US regulator has approved permanent reporting rules for certain event contracts as more companies look to launch prediction markets.

items.title: BlackRock launches tokenized money market fund accepting stablecoins in Hong Kong
items.summary: The tokenized fund launched with approximately $100 million in assets, with Standard Chartered and Ant International participating as seed investors.

items.title: Bitcoin slides amid US tariff nerves as Anthropic falls below IPO price
items.summary: Bitcoin gave up gains above $60,000 as tariff concerns weighed on US stocks and Anthropic shares hit new lows below $76.

items.title: How South Korea’s proposed 20% cap could change who runs Upbit
items.summary: Naver Financial agreed to buy every share in Upbit’s operator, but a proposed ownership cap could strip away its voting rights on four-fifths of them.

items.title: USDT buyers face 22% VAT when Moscow Exchange opens crypto trading
items.summary: Buyers will pay VAT on top of the trade price in December because Russia’s tax code has no explicit exemption for foreign digital instruments.

items.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Insiders Fear Their Next AI Models Are Too Dangerous to Release
items.summary: Employees at both AI labs reportedly question whether their strongest models should ever reach the public, as researchers struggle to keep increasingly capable systems under control during training and testing.

items.title: Anthropic’s Claude Ship Lets AI Write, Review and Approve Its Own Code
items.summary: Anthropic’s new coding tools can review and repair software changes before approving them for release, leaving development teams to decide when a human still needs to check the AI’s work.

items.title: Coldcard Bitcoin Exploit, Revisited: How a Hidden Flaw Survived Years of Audits
items.summary: Coinkite’s postmortem reveals a software random-number generator shipped in place of the hardware one for over five years, slipping past at least 15 reviews.

items.title: Ethereum Foundation Says AI Is a More Urgent Threat Than Quantum Computing
items.summary: The Ethereum Foundation has doubled its protocol security team and is prioritizing a cryptographic overhaul as advances in AI threaten the mathematical assumptions that keep billions in crypto safe.

items.title: Bitcoin Losses Are the Worst Since FTX. Is the Bottom Near?
items.summary: Bitcoin slipped below $60,000 as realized losses nearly doubled in a week. Glassnode says the sell-off resembles past market bottoms, but another drop to $53,200 could be in the cards.

items.title: What the CFTC’s New Crypto Reserves Guidance Actually Allows—And What It Doesn’t
items.summary: Staff guidance lets swap venues and clearinghouses count Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins toward their 12-month operating-cost buffer. Here's the catch.

items.title: South Korea Moves to Lift Its ICO Ban After Nearly a Decade
items.summary: The Financial Services Commission’s draft Digital Asset Act would let domestic projects sell tokens again under IPO-style disclosure rules, reversing a 2017 ban that mostly pushed Korean issuers offshore.

items.title: Wall Street and Crypto Are in 'Extreme Fear'. What's Spooking Investors?
items.summary: Fear and Greed indexes are flashing extreme fear across stocks and crypto as Nvidia’s relief rally fades, Bitcoin falls below $60,000, and investors brace for higher interest rates

items.title: What Is Pons? The Robinhood Chain Meme Coin Launchpad Explained
items.summary: Pons lets anyone launch a fixed-supply token on Robinhood Chain in one transaction. Here's how it works, and what its PONS token does.

items.title: Ansem Meme Coin Crashes After $2.57 Million Wallet Drain, Bullpen Confirms Security Breach
items.summary: Bullpen identified unauthorized transfers from as many as 19 early accounts after millions moved from wallets linked to Ansem.
